title: Valuation Bounds When the Center Meets the Negative Part
statement: Let $X$ be a smooth Fano threefold, let $P\in S\subset X$, and for $u\in[0,\tau]$ write the Zariski decomposition $-K_X-uS=P(u)+N(u)$. If $P\in\operatorname{Supp}N(u)$ for some $u$, find $K>0$ such that $\frac{3}{(-K_X)^3}\int_0^\tau P(u)^2\cdot S\cdot\operatorname{ord}_F(N(u)|_S)\,du\leq K A_S(F)$ for every prime divisor $F$ over $X$.
